title: Puffco Proxy Silicone Travel Pipe
description:
The Proxy Travel Pipe is a dry pipe accessory for the Proxy ecosystem. The silicone body is shatter-proof and easily portable, featuring a built-in storage pocket for dual tools – or anything else you may want for consuming on the go. Whether you’re hiking the hills or braving the sidewalks of city life, the Proxy Travel Pipe is ready for anything.

Product Features:
– Compatible with the Puffco Proxy Vaporizer
– Silicone body
– Built-in storage pocket
– Can be used with the Proxy Flower Bowl

What’s Included:
1 x Proxy Travel Pipe
